place_name: PICKUP COFFEE - Plaza de Bole, Torres St.
review_text: The coffee here is a steal for the price! I ordered via Grab and was impressed by how securely the drinks were packaged—everything arrived perfectly. If you go there yourself, keep in mind it’s right by the road and only have outside chairs, so it can get super hot if you stay there. For the taste and the price tho, you really can't complain. A solid choice for your daily brew!

place_name: PICKUP COFFEE - Plaza de Bole, Torres St.
review_text: This Pickup Coffee, like the others, was good. Pickup Coffee is consistently good with their service and affordable coffee, at least with my experiences. I was greeted and decided on the Kape Sua Da (Vietnamese Latte). It was bold, lightly sweetened with just a little cream. I liked it!

place_name: PICKUP COFFEE - Plaza de Bole, Torres St.
review_text: Affordable coffee. This branch is located in the former caltex gasoline station. It is beside the road so expect it to be noisy and dusty. Great for take out.
